name: Potiphar
summary: An officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard who bought Joseph. He put Joseph in charge of his whole house, then had him thrown into prison.

key_moments.title: Buying Joseph
key_moments.description: Potiphar bought Joseph from the traders who brought him to Egypt. Seeing that the LORD made everything Joseph did succeed, he put him in charge of all he owned.

key_moments.title: Sends Joseph to Prison
key_moments.description: When his wife accused Joseph, Potiphar grew angry. He put Joseph in the prison where the king's prisoners were held.
